about.title: A little clarity goes a long way.
about.description: About Finflo — practical calculators with visible methods, clear assumptions, and results you can understand.

sections.title: Built for everyday decisions
paragraphs: Finflo brings money, health, math, and everyday calculations into one place. Our aim is simple: make the calculation easy to use and the reasoning easy to inspect.
Choose a tool, enter your own values, and explore the formula and assumptions beside the result. Most calculations run in your browser without an account; road mileage uses external map services.

sections.title: Our approach
paragraphs: A useful answer needs context. We identify units, distinguish estimates from exact arithmetic, and explain the supported model. When a tool depends on regional rules or a particular year, that scope belongs on the page.
Finflo is an independent project. It is not affiliated with Calculator.net, government agencies, or the organizations cited as references.

sections.title: Editorial responsibility
paragraphs: Finflo is responsible for the site and its explanations. We do not claim that every page has been reviewed by a licensed professional. The methodology page describes the calculation and verification process.

sections.title: Site operator
paragraphs: Finflo is operated by Erush in the United States. For questions or corrections, use the contact details below.

contact.title: Let’s make the numbers clearer.
contact.description: Contact Finflo with a question, calculation issue, accessibility problem, or correction.

sections.title: Contact Finflo
paragraphs: Email the address below with questions, feedback, or a problem using Finflo.

sections.title: Report a calculation issue
paragraphs: Include the tool name, selected calculation mode, expected result, and the formula or source you used. An example with fictional inputs is usually enough to reproduce the issue.
Please avoid sending medical records, financial account details, passwords, or other sensitive personal information. We cannot provide individual financial, tax, legal, or medical advice.

sections.title: Accessibility feedback
paragraphs: Tell us which page or control caused a problem, your browser, and any assistive technology involved. We welcome reproducible reports and suggestions.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: How Finflo handles calculator inputs, reference-data requests, local files, contact messages, and browser tools.

sections.title: Calculator inputs and results
paragraphs: Most calculations run in your browser without an account. Road mileage sends selected locations to map services. Reference-data modes retrieve public snapshots without sending your entered amount or selected pair. The privacy policy explains local files, sharing, and optional browser-assistant tools.

Copy tool link copies the page address without your calculator values. CSV downloads are created in your browser. If you copy, download, print, email, or otherwise share a result, the destination you choose may receive it.

sections.title: Your local workspace
paragraphs: Favorites and calculations are stored on this device only when you choose to save them. My workspace lets you reopen, rename, compare, delete, export, and import them. Nothing syncs to other devices automatically.
Clearing site data removes your workspace. Backup files include saved inputs and results; keep them somewhere you trust. Passwords and encoding-tool contents cannot be saved to the workspace.

sections.title: Currency reference data
paragraphs: Some currency modes request a shared reference-data snapshot from Finflo’s server. The server obtains public data from sources including the European Central Bank, Frankfurter, Coinbase, and Chile’s Servicio de Impuestos Internos. Your amount and selected currency pair are used locally and are not included in these reference-data requests.

Reference snapshots may be cached by the server, your browser, or hosting infrastructure. The calculator shows available source dates and identifies reference or spot values. Manual-rate calculations do not need a reference-data request.

sections.title: Road mileage and place searches
paragraphs: Selecting Find place sends that search to Nominatim through Finflo. Selecting Calculate on the mileage tool sends the two route coordinates to the FOSSGIS OpenStreetMap routing service through Finflo. Finflo sends requests only when you use these controls; it does not use location autocomplete or request your device location.

Finflo temporarily caches place-search responses in server memory for up to 24 hours and routes for up to five minutes to reduce provider requests. These bounded caches are not a saved trip history. Map providers may log requests under their own privacy policies. Do not submit locations you do not want those services to receive.

sections.title: Local files and text utilities
paragraphs: The Base64 file tool reads only a file you select. Finflo converts its contents in your browser and creates a local download; the tool does not upload the file or its filename to Finflo. Text encoding, decoding, and password generation also run locally.

Downloaded files remain wherever you save them until you remove them. Your browser, extensions, operating system, and any application you use to open or share a file operate under their own settings and policies.

sections.title: Optional browser-assistant tools
paragraphs: A compatible browser or assistant may offer tools that interact with Finflo’s calculators. When you invoke a supported calculation through that service, it can supply inputs, update the visible form, and receive the calculation’s result and notes. That browser or assistant’s own privacy practices apply to information it handles.
Finflo does not require this integration. Ordinary calculator controls work without it. Finflo does not register password generation, Base64, or URL encoding and decoding as assistant tools.

sections.title: Website requests and hosting
paragraphs: Opening pages and requesting reference data sends ordinary connection information to the hosting infrastructure, such as your IP address, browser details, requested URL, and request time. Search terms entered in the site’s search are included in the search-page URL. Hosting providers may process request and security logs to deliver and protect the service.
Finflo does not currently provide visitor accounts or store calculator inputs in an application database.

Finflo is hosted on Railway. Railway processes connection and service logs to operate the website. Log availability and retention depend on the hosting account and plan; Finflo does not claim a fixed retention period here.

sections.title: Cookies, advertising, and analytics
paragraphs: Finflo currently loads no advertising networks, marketing analytics, or optional tracking cookies. Your browser may cache pages, code, and public reference data so they can load again more quickly.
If these practices change, we will update this notice and provide any relevant preferences before enabling the new service.

When you choose a country or currency, Finflo stores those preferences in this browser’s local storage so they can apply on future visits. Calculator inputs and results are not saved with these preferences. Use “Use language defaults” in the language menu, or clear site data in your browser, to remove them. If browser storage is unavailable, preferences apply only for the current page session.

Saved world clocks and your default clock are stored in this browser when you choose Save clock or Make default. Remove saved clocks individually or clear site data to remove clock preferences. The countdown timer uses this tab’s session storage to restore its state after a reload; this session data normally lasts until the tab is closed. Stopwatch laps stay only on the open page.

sections.title: Contact messages
paragraphs: If you email Finflo, your email provider and ours process the message. We use the information you send to respond to your request or investigate the reported issue. Please use fictional examples when reporting a calculation problem and avoid including unnecessary personal information.
For privacy questions or requests about information you have sent to us, use the contact details on our Contact page. We cannot retrieve calculator inputs that were never sent to or saved by Finflo.

sections.title: External links and updates
paragraphs: External sources and services linked from Finflo have their own privacy practices. This notice describes Finflo’s current functionality.
Last updated October 11, 2026.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.description: Terms for using Finflo’s calculators, explanations, and utilities.

sections.title: Using the site
paragraphs: Finflo provides general calculation tools and educational explanations. Use the tools within their documented inputs, supported models, and limitations. You remain responsible for checking whether those assumptions fit your situation.
Do not disrupt the service, probe it without authorization, introduce malicious content, or use it to violate applicable law.

sections.title: Estimates and professional advice
paragraphs: A mathematically correct output can still be an unsuitable estimate when its assumptions do not match reality. Tax, lending, medical, building, and other consequential decisions may require a qualified professional and current authoritative information.
Finflo does not create a financial advisory, healthcare, legal, or other professional relationship. Outputs do not guarantee outcomes, eligibility, safety, compliance, or returns.

sections.title: Availability and corrections
paragraphs: We may update formulas, explanations, features, and availability. We aim to correct reported defects, but do not warrant uninterrupted access or that every result is free of error.
These terms do not exclude rights or remedies that cannot lawfully be excluded.

sections.title: Content and attribution
paragraphs: Finflo’s original interface and explanations are provided for use with the site. External trademarks and sources belong to their respective owners. References do not imply endorsement.
Last updated October 9, 2026. Contact Finflo with questions about these terms.

cookies.title: Cookies and preferences
cookies.description: Finflo’s current cookie and tracking practices.

sections.title: Cookies and tracking
paragraphs: Finflo currently uses no advertising networks, marketing analytics, or optional tracking cookies.
Inputs stay in this browser only when you choose Save calculation. Manage saved results and backups in My workspace.

When you choose a country or currency, Finflo stores those preferences in this browser’s local storage so they can apply on future visits. Calculator inputs and results are not saved with these preferences. Use “Use language defaults” in the language menu, or clear site data in your browser, to remove them. If browser storage is unavailable, preferences apply only for the current page session.

Saved world clocks and your default clock are stored in this browser when you choose Save clock or Make default. Remove saved clocks individually or clear site data to remove clock preferences. The countdown timer uses this tab’s session storage to restore its state after a reload; this session data normally lasts until the tab is closed. Stopwatch laps stay only on the open page.

sections.title: Changes to these practices
paragraphs: We will update this page and provide relevant preferences before adding optional tracking.

disclaimer.title: Understand what an estimate can tell you.
disclaimer.description: Financial, medical, engineering, and general limitations of Finflo’s calculation tools.

sections.title: Financial and tax tools
paragraphs: Results use the values and assumptions shown. Rates, fees, taxes, eligibility, and local rules can change. Estimates are not a quote, a tax return, investment advice, or an assurance of future performance.
Federal wage-tax estimates do not constitute a complete tax computation. Historical or assumed investment returns do not predict future returns.

sections.title: Health and fitness tools
paragraphs: Health outputs are estimates or screening references, not diagnoses or individual treatment instructions. Population formulas may not apply to children, pregnancy, athletes, or people with particular conditions unless a specific method says otherwise.
Discuss medical interpretation with a qualified clinician. Do not use a BAC estimate to decide whether to drive, or a calendar-based fertility estimate as contraception.

sections.title: Construction, electrical, and other tools
paragraphs: Material quantities and physical models omit conditions identified on each page. Outputs do not certify structural integrity, electrical safety, code compliance, or a complete project specification.
For safety-critical work, use current standards and a qualified professional. Entertainment utilities, including the name-match game, have no predictive validity.

editorial-policy.title: Editorial policy
editorial-policy.description: How Finflo selects references, writes explanations, and handles corrections.

sections.title: Original, useful explanations
paragraphs: We write for the person trying to understand a result. Explanations should identify what the output means, the units involved, the formula used, and the conditions where the calculation is useful.
Finflo’s explanations and interface are original. References support the calculation methods and help you check their assumptions.

sections.title: Sources and expertise
paragraphs: We prioritize original papers, official government and statistical sources, recognized standards, and primary technical documentation. A citation supports the stated method; it does not imply that the source endorses Finflo.
We do not invent named reviewers, professional credentials, ratings, or customer testimonials. If professional review is commissioned, the actual reviewer and scope should be disclosed.

sections.title: Corrections and updates
paragraphs: Changes to formulas and data should include tests of the affected behavior. Year-dependent tools need a stated year and a documented update process. A page should not imply a fresh expert review merely because its build date changed.
Report a possible error through Contact with a reproducible example. When a tool depends on unavailable data, a licensed service, or an unverified method, its page explains the limitation.

sections.title: Review schedule
paragraphs: We review time-dependent sources before adding a new supported year and when a relevant official update is identified. Source-link checks run weekly; formula, language and browser checks accompany affected releases.

A working reference link does not prove that every statement is current. Translations receive separate review for numbers, units, scope and meaning. Automated checks do not replace specialist or fluent-language review.

methodology.title: The method matters as much as the answer.
methodology.description: Finflo’s approach to formulas, input validation, numerical precision, and verification.

sections.title: Visible assumptions
paragraphs: Each tool identifies its supported calculation modes and units. Formula descriptions and source links are available as page text, alongside illustrative inputs and results. A financial model, a biological estimate, and exact arithmetic carry different uncertainty.

sections.title: Calculation and precision
paragraphs: Most engines use JavaScript numerical arithmetic. Fractions, large integers, address ranges, and selected decimal operations use appropriate exact or higher-precision representations. Display rounding is separate from internal arithmetic where practical.

Inputs are checked for missing values, invalid units, impossible dates, division by zero, and model-specific restrictions. Extreme cases can exceed a method’s supported numerical range; those should return a useful error rather than a plausible-looking invalid answer.

sections.title: Verification and coverage
paragraphs: We check representative calculations against independently derived examples and source references, and test edge cases such as invalid dates, boundary values, and unit conversions. These checks reduce errors but cannot prove that every possible input is correct.

A calculator’s page describes the implemented methods and their limitations. A matching name does not mean it reproduces every feature of another service. Methods that rely on unavailable data or proprietary rules are identified where relevant.

sections.title: Privacy by design
paragraphs: Most calculations run in your browser without an account. Road mileage sends selected locations to map services. Reference-data modes retrieve public snapshots without sending your entered amount or selected pair. The privacy policy explains local files, sharing, and optional browser-assistant tools.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.description: Finflo’s accessibility approach and how to report a barrier.

sections.title: A practical, usable website
paragraphs: We aim for WCAG 2.2 AA. The interface uses semantic headings, labeled controls, keyboard focus indicators, status announcements, and text or table alternatives to charts.
We have not claimed accessibility certification or a completed independent audit. Automated checks help find problems, but they cannot verify every interaction or assistive-technology combination.

sections.title: Using the calculators
paragraphs: Use the skip link to move to the page content. Calculator modes use a standard select control. Results can be read as text, and detailed data is available in tables. Layouts adapt to narrow screens and reduced-motion preferences.

sections.title: Tell us about a barrier
paragraphs: Email {contactEmail} with the page, browser, assistive technology, and a short description of the task that was difficult.
